svg.title: Architecture of polaris
svg.desc: A browser signs in through Cloudflare Access to the polaris Worker in your Cloudflare account. The Worker serves the dashboard app, keeps answers in the Cache API, and reads usage from the GraphQL Analytics API and resource names from the Cloudflare API with a read-only API token. pnpm stack:deploy on your machine creates the Access application and the Worker.
svg.text: then reads usage when a page opens
keeps answers for a few minutes
creates or updates the Access application and the Worker,
and tags them as one stack (Resource Tagging)
